tagline: Two dim mates. One very hot burger.

    StartersMutt Cutts road snacksPotato chips, cheese puffs and dog bone pretzels for the road.How to make it60g potato chips60g cheese puffs60g dog-bone-shaped pretzelsTip the potato chips, cheese puffs and dog-bone-shaped pretzels into a big shared bowl.Toss gently.Share between four people for the road trip.Truck stop onion ringsThick buttermilk soaked onion rings in puffed golden beer batter.How to make it2 brown onions150ml buttermilk120g plain flour150ml lager1/4 tsp salt1 L neutral oil, for fryingSlice the onions into thick rings and soak in the buttermilk.Whisk the flour with the cold lager and salt.Heat the oil to 185°C.Drain the onions, dip in the batter and fry in small batches until puffed and golden.Drain and salt lightly.Petey's seeded crackers and herb creamFor Petey, whose head has fallen offHow to make itAs written, serves 4Homemade seeded crackers loaded with sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds, with a cream cheese whipped with chives, dill and lemon for dipping.Mix 60g each of sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds with 30g chia seeds, 60g plain flour, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp olive oil and 200ml water.Stand 15 minutes, then spread very thin between sheets of baking paper.Bake at 160°C for 45 minutes, peel off the top sheet, and bake 15 minutes more until crisp.Snap into shards.Beat 250g cream cheese with chopped chives, dill, lemon zest and pepper.Hot pepper beef taquitosExtra hot, the way Harry and Lloyd fix Mental's burger.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsExtra hot chilli burgerBeef patty with cheddar, beef chilli and pickled jalapeños.How to make it700g beef mince1 onion, diced1 tsp vegetable oil1 tsp chilli powder1/2 tsp ground cumin200g tinned tomatoes, chopped100ml water1 tsp salt80g cheddar, sliced4 burger buns40g pickled jalapenos40ml hot sauceBrown a portion of the mince with the onion in the oil.Add the chilli powder, cumin, tomatoes and water, simmer until thick and season.Shape the remaining mince into four patties.Griddle over medium-high heat until cooked through (75°C at the centre) and top with cheddar to melt.Toast the buns and fill with patties, chilli and jalapenos.Put the hot sauce on the table for anyone wanting the extra-hot version.Aspen room service surf and turfLobster and the works on someone else's moneyHow to make itAs written, serves 4Grilled lobster tails in garlic parsley butter beside seared sirloin, with crunchy double-cooked chips and a bowl of béarnaise to share.Cut 800g potatoes into chips, fry at 140°C for 6 minutes, then at 190°C for 3 minutes.Split 4 lobster tails and brush with 60g butter melted with 2 garlic cloves and parsley, then grill flesh side up 6 to 8 minutes.Season 4 small sirloin steaks and sear 3 minutes a side, then rest.Whisk 3 egg yolks with 1 tbsp tarragon vinegar over simmering water, then slowly whisk in 150g melted butter and chopped tarragon.Serve together.SweetsAspen snowflake cookiesVanilla sugar cookies with white icing and silver cachous.How to make it80g butter, softened60g caster sugar1 egg yolk1/2 tsp vanilla extract130g plain flour80g icing sugar2 tsp water10g edible silver cachousBeat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the yolk and vanilla.Mix in the flour and chill.Roll 5mm thick and cut into eight snowflakes.Bake at 180°C until pale gold at the edges.Cool completely.Mix the icing sugar with the water to a spreadable icing, coat the cookies and decorate with cachous.DrinksSki lodge hot chocolateFrothy dark chocolate milk with whipped cream and marshmallows.How to make it600ml full cream milk100g dark chocolate, chopped80ml thickened cream40g marshmallowsHeat the milk until steaming without boiling.Add the chocolate and whisk until melted and frothy.Divide among four mugs.Softly whip
